name: Mission Trips
overview: Mission trips are a vital expression of the Great Commission, as Jesus commands His followers to go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit (Matthew 28:18-19). The call to be courageous and confident in God's presence (Joshua 1:9) empowers believers to respond to His invitation to serve, much like Isaiah's willing declaration, 'Here am I; send me' (Isaiah 6:8). The urgency of the mission is underscored by Jesus' instruction to pray for more laborers to enter the harvest, emphasizing the vast need for gospel proclamation worldwide (Luke 10:2; Matthew 24:14).
